findings.location: skill steps 2 and 4 versus input-contract decision rules
findings.evidence: Step 2 directs the skill to `define the minimum condition for a run to begin`, and step 4 directs it to `define what counts as completion and what record would evidence it`. The contract separately requires missing inputs or completion evidence to remain contract gaps, and the incomplete-conflicting eval expects missing inputs and evidence to be listed rather than supplied by the skill.
findings.consequence: When the request omits start or completion criteria, these drafting commands can cause the skill to invent operative prerequisites or success evidence and present an incomplete recurrence as bounded.
findings.correction: Direct the skill to record supplied start and completion criteria. When either is absent, list it as unresolved; any candidate criterion may be shown only as a clearly labeled, non-operative proposal requiring owner approval.
